newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge mum on Ascend rumors.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge mum on Ascend rumors.

text.p: Newbridge Networks Corp declined to comment Friday on rumors that it was in talks to set up a technology alliance with Ascend Communications Inc.
"Obviously, we do not comment on or respond to rumor or speculation," Newbridge spokesman Paul Goyette said.
Analysts have also said that Newbridge is giving indications that third quarter will not disappoint.
"Management has provided guidance in line with the way things are trending," Goyette said. He declined to elaborate further on the nature of the direction Newbridge is giving financial analysts.
